connections.title: Vehicle register (RDW)
connections.description: Fills a company car's make, model, first admission date, catalogue value and fuel type from its licence plate, through the RDW open data.

connections.title: Population register (BRP)
connections.description: Fills an employee's name, date of birth and address by BSN, for an employer that records a legal basis for it. The certificate stays with the credential broker.

connections.title: Accounting ledger (shillinq)
connections.description: Payroll journal entries and net-pay payment runs go to shillinq. Humaniq reports whether shillinq took its last handoff.

connections.title: Pension fund delivery (UPA)
connections.description: Sends the payroll figures a pension fund needs in the UPA message.
connections.unavailableMessage: The UPA message is specified in filings-pension-upa-message and not built yet.

connections.title: Occupational health service
connections.description: Passes sick reports and recovery to the occupational health service.
connections.unavailableMessage: Sick reports reach the arbodienst by hand today.

connections.title: Learning platform
connections.description: Keeps training enrolments and completions in step with a learning platform.
connections.unavailableMessage: The learning sync is specified in talent-training-and-lms.

connections.title: Outside payroll bureau
connections.description: Hands the payroll input to an outside payroll bureau and takes its results back.
connections.unavailableMessage: The handoff is specified in payroll-external-bureau-handoff.
